metrics.name: tip_rate
metrics.label: Tip rate (card trips)
metrics.definition: Tips divided by metered fare, valid card trips only.
metrics.sql_expression: sum(sum_tip_amount_recorded) filter (where quality_status = 'valid') / nullif(sum(sum_fare_amount_tip_recorded) filter (where quality_status = 'valid'), 0)
metrics.filters: valid trips paid by card only

provenance.rendered_sql:
SELECT sum(sum_tip_amount_recorded) filter (where quality_status = 'valid') / nullif(sum(sum_fare_amount_tip_recorded) filter (where quality_status = 'valid'), 0) AS tip_rate
FROM analytics.mv_trips_daily AS a
WHERE a.month_start IN (SELECT source_month FROM analytics.recon_bronze_silver) AND a.month_start = ANY(ARRAY['2026-08-01']::date[]) AND (a.pickup_borough)::text = ANY(ARRAY['Brooklyn'])
ORDER BY tip_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

metrics.name: tip_rate
metrics.label: Tip rate (card trips)
metrics.definition: Tips divided by metered fare, valid card trips only.
metrics.sql_expression: sum(sum_tip_amount_recorded) filter (where quality_status = 'valid') / nullif(sum(sum_fare_amount_tip_recorded) filter (where quality_status = 'valid'), 0)
metrics.filters: valid trips paid by card only

provenance.rendered_sql:
SELECT a.pickup_borough AS pickup_borough, sum(sum_tip_amount_recorded) filter (where quality_status = 'valid') / nullif(sum(sum_fare_amount_tip_recorded) filter (where quality_status = 'valid'), 0) AS tip_rate
FROM analytics.mv_trips_daily AS a
WHERE a.month_start IN (SELECT source_month FROM analytics.recon_bronze_silver) AND a.month_start = ANY(ARRAY['2026-08-01']::date[]) AND (a.pickup_borough)::text = ANY(ARRAY['Queens'])
GROUP BY a.pickup_borough
ORDER BY tip_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

metrics.name: total_revenue
metrics.label: Total revenue
metrics.definition: Sum of total_amount of valid trips (USD). Includes the metered fare, extras, MTA tax, tolls, improvement surcharge, NYS congestion surcharge, airport fee, CBD congestion fee and recorded tips. Cash tips are not recorded by the meter.

provenance.rendered_sql:
SELECT a.pickup_borough AS pickup_borough, CASE WHEN a.month_start = ANY(ARRAY['2026-09-01']::date[]) THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period_role, sum(sum_total_amount) filter (where quality_status = 'valid') AS total_revenue
FROM analytics.mv_trips_daily AS a
WHERE a.month_start IN (SELECT source_month FROM analytics.recon_bronze_silver) AND a.month_start = ANY(ARRAY['2026-09-01', '2026-08-01']::date[])
GROUP BY a.pickup_borough, CASE WHEN a.month_start = ANY(ARRAY['2026-09-01']::date[]) THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END
LIMIT 5000

turns.question: How accurate was the May forecast?

answer.question: How accurate was the May forecast?
answer.narrative: The forecast of May 2026 (the seasonal baseline, replayed as at the time) missed by 9.2 % per borough and day, against 9.2 % promised by its backtests: as expected. Overall it was 2.5 % too low, and 88 % of the borough-days fell inside its 80 % range. Largest errors: EWR (109.2 %), Staten Island (35.8 %), Bronx (18.1 %).
answer.suggested_followup: How many trips are expected next month?
limitations: The error is that of the forecast as it was published, measured once the month's trips were recorded.
reasons: forecast: accuracy from the monthly forecast-against-actual check

metrics.name: forecast_error
metrics.label: Forecast error per borough and day
metrics.definition: Share of the recorded value missed or over-counted (WMAPE) by the published trips forecast, per borough and day.
metrics.filters: the live check of the month, else its replay

provenance.rendered_sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (target, month) *
    FROM ml.forecast_check_run
    WHERE target = 'trips'
    ORDER BY target, month, (actual_wmape IS NULL OR actual_wmape = 'NaN'), replay,
             checked_at DESC
)
SELECT l.month, l.method, l.replay, l.status, l.expected_wmape::float AS expected,
       s.segment AS pickup_borough, s.wmape::float AS forecast_error,
       s.bias::float AS forecast_bias, s.coverage_80::float AS coverage,
       s.predicted::float AS forecast, s.actual::float AS recorded
FROM latest AS l JOIN ml.forecast_check AS s USING (run_id)
WHERE s.segment_type = 'borough_day'
  AND l.month = coalesce('2026-05', (SELECT max(month) FROM latest))
ORDER BY s.segment = 'all' DESC, s.wmape DESC
LIMIT 12
provenance.data_layer: ml (forecast against actual, read-only role ai_reader)
